title: Paper White 2: the wild encounters' settings, res/paperwhite2/encounters/settings.json
description: What applies to every species of the wild encounters (docs/paperwhite2/encounters.md): the rarity tiers, the level gate, the hidden ability's chance, the default battle styles, the rustling spots' rule and the outbreaks' share. The scaled level's percent and spread are the conditions engine's, res/paperwhite2/level_scaling.json. Packed by tools/paperwhite2/encounters.py into the last member of the wild encounters' archive (a/1/2/7).

tiers.description: The rarity tiers, most common first. Each takes its share of a place's encounters by one method, split evenly among its Pokémon there; the shares of the tiers present are rescaled to make 100%.

level_gate.description: What a species' minimum level is compared with to decide whether it appears: the party's median level, or the scaled level

hidden_ability.description: The chance in percent that a wild Pokémon has its hidden ability, unless its species sets its own

battles.description: The battle styles of a species that sets none

rustling.description: Rustling spots: each kind gives its fixed thing at a fixed share, and the rest to the spots' own habitats and the area's Pokémon of these tiers found by these methods. With no Pokémon there, the fixed thing is all they give.

outbreak_share.description: An outbreak's share, in percent, of its place's encounters by its methods on its day

import.description: The editor's import from the original slot tables: a share's tier is the first whose threshold it reaches; an evolving species' maximum is the level it evolves at plus the margin

partners.description: Who joins a double or triple battle: the same evolutionary family, or anything that can appear there, each meeting its own levels and conditions
